scope.ageBasis: The official primary Grades 1–2 window is 6–8 in the pinned NCFSE October 2024 edition, PDF211. Each 2025 printed grade remains explicit; no per-grade cutoff is invented.

coverageMeaning: Full is source-fit authoring, not learner attainment. Three mixed skill/contextual records retain actual production/performance/comprehension alongside a separate engagement channel; they are not reduced to attitude alone. All positions remain suggestive, not formal mandates.

identifierDisclosure: The source keys identify generated printed positions, not official NCERT outcome bullet codes. G1 C11.1 LO02 and LO06 are preserved separate positions and use one shared syllable claim; counts do not mean distinct mastery skills.
languageBoundary: This source explicitly selects English as L2. English letter, phonics and print requirements are appropriate here but do not establish the formal role framework’s R2 or transfer mastery to any arbitrary language.
